reviews.notes: Claude final review: P2 candidate 1 (Texture 20 + Auto Rig 20) normalized facing -Y. Clearly better than v1 (d1b8c2): sharper hair strands, cleaner face, same outfit. Sol needs-work items (armpit gaps on arm raise, braid shift on right-arm raise, angular fingertips, flat gold, skirt flecks) accepted as known defects for the demo; idle/walk do not raise arms overhead. Engine test (import, retarget, walk) next. Not game-ready.
